name: model-router
description: Sends quick questions to Claude Haiku 5.5 to save usage; everything else stays on your model.

maxContextTokens.title: Largest conversation to route, in tokens
maxContextTokens.description: Past this, a routed turn would send the whole conversation uncached to Haiku, whose input price steps up past 100K tokens; your model reading its own cache is then cheaper, so turns stay put.
